 Follow Christina Ricci Just Detailed What Caused Her Abrupt Falling Out With Cher
 Stephanie Soteriou Wed, November 18, 2026 at 5:35 PM UTC 5 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. While Christina Ricci is known for a whole bunch of iconic roles, including Wednesday Addams in the Addams Family movie franchise, Kat Harvey in Casper , Roberta Martin in Now and Then , and, more recently, Misty Quigley in Yellowjackets , her big-screen debut was in the 1990 movie Mermaids alongside Cher and Winona Ryder , when she was just 9 years old.
 ©Orion Pictures Corp/Courtesy Everett Collection
 In the movie, Christina plays Cher's daughter, and she has always praised the star for being incredibly protective of her at the time. In the 2024 documentary Child Star , Christina said : "Cher took me under her wing, and she recognized that sometimes you could be on a set, and you don't know exactly what is going on behind the scenes — power struggles, or different issues."
 ©Orion Pictures Corp/Courtesy Everett Collection
 Related: "Pick Between These Pop Culture Icons, And We'll Guess Your Exact Age" 
 She explained that Cher was sure to make it clear to Christina that any problems on the set were nothing to do with her, and she also remembered spending a lot of her downtime in Cher's trailer, too. When asked if she considered Cher her mentor, Christina said that she did — and credited working with strong women early in her career for teaching her important lessons about setting boundaries in Hollywood.
 William Nation / Getty Images
 And Christina was still speaking warmly about her former costar as recently as 2024. During an appearance on The Drew Barrymore Show , she recalled Cher patiently answering all of her questions about acting — even when she could have been preoccupied with other things. Christina then asserted: "Honestly, every good thing you believe about Cher is true."
 CBS / Via youtube.com 
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Their relationship flourished off set, too, with Christina revealing in a 2018 interview with the AV Club that after she and Winona shot the music video for Cher's song "The Shoop Shoop Song (It's in His Kiss)," which was released to promote Mermaids , Cher took her back to her Malibu home for a pajama party. Christina described this experience as "really just a fantastic, idyllic memory."
 Cher / Via youtube.com 
 But in the same profile, Christina revealed that she lost touch with Cher a decade after their first meeting. She shared: "I haven't [spoken to her] in a long time. But I did for about 10 years after the movie. We were in touch, but we have since lost touch, which I regret very much, because she's an incredible person."
 VALERIE MACON / Getty Images
 Related: "These Celebs Look Unrecognizable In Old Photos — How Many Can You Identify?" 
 The star did not share any more information on this at the time, but during Tuesday's episode of Watch What Happens Live with Andy Cohen, Christina lifted the lid on the unfortunate misunderstanding that she believes led to the demise of their relationship after Andy asked if they were "still in touch."
 ©Orion / courtesy Everett Collection
 "I'm not," Christina confirmed. "Unfortunately, she's still mad at me. She holds a grudge."
 Bravo / Via youtube.com 
 Advertisement Advertisement Related: "15 Stars Who Left Nothing To The Imagination On The Red Carpet" 
 When asked what had happened, Christina then explained: "Well, when I was 19, I did some Rolling Stone thing, and they interviewed her. Maybe it wasn't Rolling Stone; it might have been Premiere, but they interviewed her, and she said all these things that were not that amazing about me. And then she left me a voicemail about how journalists are always trying to get the worst things, and blah, blah, blah, and she was so sorry. And I was 19, and so I didn't return that message."
 Bravo / Via youtube.com 
 "Oh, so she was mad at you for not returning the message?" Andy asked, to which Christina said: "I'm pretty sure. Because I've reached out to her since and gotten radio silence."
 Bravo / Via youtube.com 
 When Andy noted how "highly" Christina has spoken about Cher over the years, she quickly said: "Oh, I adore her. She's the best." She went on to insist that she totally understands Cher's perspective, too, adding: "I absolutely, 100% can imagine being Cher and being like: 'Oh my god, they misquoted me, and I'm gonna call this young person and explain to her that they misquoted me,' and then the gall of that young person to not return the call and be like: 'Oh my god, Cher, it's OK. I love you so much…' Like, I would be so pissed. I get it. Do you know what I'm saying?"
 Bravo / Via youtube.com 
 Christina then shared her hope that she and Cher could reconcile, saying directly into the camera: "Love you, Cher! I love you so much!"
 Bravo / Via youtube.com 
 Advertisement Advertisement Related: "15 Celebrities Who Became Fathers Before They Were Even Old Enough To Rent A Car" 
 But while Christina made it clear that she's on Cher's side with the whole thing, many people have been left shocked by the music icon's behavior, with one response to the story reading : "Wait, the beef is allegedly over her simply not returning an apology phone call decades ago? If true, that's ridiculously petty."
 ANGELA WEISS / Getty Images
 Another noted : "Cher blaming the journalist for things she said isn't a true apology." Somebody else commented : "Cher's in the wrong here 🙄 like c'mon." Over on X, a popular quote-tweet adds : "I don't get it that's so dumb of Cher 💀." While one more concluded : "I think it's time to get tf over it, Cher."
 What are your thoughts? Let me know down below!
